yt_description:
Ever seen an algorithm that's as busy as a bartender? 🍹 Meet Cocktail Sort! We're breaking down this unique sorting algorithm with a mind-blowing visualization that'll have you saying 'Cheers!' to efficient code. 🤓

This isn't your average bubble sort. Cocktail Sort (also known as bidirectional bubble sort, shaker sort, ripple sort, shuffle sort, or shuttle sort) sorts in both directions, making it a bit more zippy. Watch as we animate its journey to perfectly ordered data! ✨
